stage: M64 fixed support-change diagnostic; no fitting
population: All18 M61 final models, all14 M63 source-group holdout pairs, both endpoints, source/final/identity. No selection.
decomposition: For raw encoder coordinates a_r,a_d and selected atom supports q_r,q_d: full decoded change = scale*D[(a_d-a_r)*q_r + a_d*(q_d-q_r)]. Use actual independently selected donor/recipient supports. The first term changes coordinates within recipient support; the second switches support. Also record symmetric donor-anchored decomposition to expose anchor dependence.
local_metrics: Raw native/full/within/switch squared norms, inner products, native-direction squared errors; support overlap and changed atom counts. Verify sum against actual float32 reconstructed difference; report cancellation ratios only with explicit denominators. Shared atoms counted once by union.
causal_test: On the original native recipient background, apply within-recipient-support direction, switch-only direction, and full direction at fixed positions. Full direction must replay M63; zero and identity controls retained. Compare full-vocabulary native-weighted final response errors and answer margins to unchanged native teacher. Donor-anchored decomposition is a local sensitivity diagnostic, not additional native interventions.
prediction: If inaccurate support changes dominate failures, removing the switch term should improve native response fidelity despite losing part of full reconstructed change. If continuous coordinate errors dominate, freezing support will not systematically rescue fidelity. Correct clustering may require support changes, so improvement/worsening is contextual evidence, not proof of native manifolds. Nonlinear response interactions are not additive attribution.
verification: Independently recompute supports from frozen encoder/membership with explicit tie checks; replay saved selected codes and full decoded directions. NumPy decomposition/energy checks; all saved final response vectors independently audited. Hash bind protocol/source/models/data. Do not change protocols after seeing results.
stop: One full fixed diagnostic, no fits or support/position/amplitude search. Report paired raw/family/pooled results including failures, then decide whether evidence supports representation-boundary validation or requires revising the featurizer. No native redundancy or new-task discovery claim.
holdouts: Existing familiar source-group development pairs only. Preserve all historical whole-task training exclusions; no new training data.
